name: BO-8 Duplicate delivery for a decided case — clean no-op
description: The named case is already decided: the claim no-ops and nothing is repeated. State-seeded integration eval: run scripts/seed_backoffice_cases.py before the batch.

backoffice_task.task_input: Webhook delivery: dispute case event for case_id EVL-BO-8. Claim and process this case.
backoffice_task.expected_behavior: Seeded facts: case EVL-BO-8 is ALREADY decided (auto_approve, credit issued, notification queued). This task is a duplicate/replayed delivery. The task must attempt the claim, receive that nothing is claimable, and complete as a no-op WITHOUT recording another decision and WITHOUT another notification. Fail ONLY if: (a) a new decision is recorded via case-decide (an already_decided no-op response from the tool is fine); (b) case-notify creates another notification (an already_queued/no-op response is fine); (c) the summary claims a new decision or new credit was produced by THIS task.
